method: sweep.py silverfish --items blocks: a silverfish with no target in a 1 x 1 pit two blocks deep cut into a 3 x 3 x 4 block of one kind, 300 ticks, three runs per kind; a host block is one the silverfish merged into (the infested block is the UpdateBlock that came with its RemoveActor), every run of every host merged; `releases` is the actor whose AddActor follows a woken block's destroy particles (sweep.py silverfish --items wake)
